# Court RCHP

> > Free legal self-help resources and education for Missouri residents covering civil law, criminal justice, consumer rights, and debt management.

Court RCHP provides accessible legal information and guidance for Missouri residents seeking to understand their rights and navigate legal processes without attorney assistance. The site aggregates educational articles, consumer guides, and references to legal aid services, with a focus on practical self-help resources and federal protections.

## Key Topics

- Missouri law
- Self-help legal information
- Consumer protection
- Debt management
- Federal law
- Legal aid resources
- Self-representation
- Consumer rights
- Attorney referral
- Bankruptcy
- Fair Debt Collection Practices Act
- Fourth Amendment rights
- Missouri gun law
- Family law
- Criminal procedure

## Getting Started with Legal Help

- [Free Legal Help in Missouri](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help): Gateway to free legal resources and aid services for Missouri residents
- [Library of Legal Articles](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles): Central hub for self-help legal articles and educational resources

## Debt & Financial Law

- [Dealing with Debt](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/dealing-with-debt): Overview of debt types, credit basics, and loan management
- [Bankruptcy Law](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/dealing-with-debt/bankruptcy-law): Comprehensive guide to bankruptcy chapters and federal debt relief process
- [Fair Debt Collection Practices Act](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/dealing-with-debt/fair-debt-collection-practices-act): Guide to FDCPA rights and protections against debt collector harassment
- [Credit Repair: Self Help May Be Best](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/dealing-with-debt/credit-repair-self-help-may-be-best): DIY credit repair guide with FTC resources and consumer protection

## Consumer Rights & Contracts

- [Contracts](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/contracts): Guide to contract types, elements, and enforcement in Missouri
- [Understanding Warranties](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/contracts/understanding-warranties): Guide to consumer warranties under Uniform Commercial Code
- [How to Buy Auto Insurance](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/contracts/how-to-buy-auto-insurance): Auto insurance buying guide covering coverage types and policy selection
- [Buying a Used Car: Tips and Things to Consider](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/buying-a-used-car-tips-and-things-to-consider): Consumer guide for purchasing used vehicles with inspection tips
- [Shopping for Funeral Services](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/contracts/shopping-for-funeral-services): Consumer guide for comparing funeral services and understanding costs

## Criminal Law & Constitutional Rights

- [Civil Cases vs. Criminal Cases](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/civil-cases-vs-criminal-cases): Explanation of differences between civil and criminal court cases
- [Going to Jail for the First Time](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/going-to-jail-for-the-first-time): Guidance on jail procedures and constitutional prisoner rights
- [Government Surveillance](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/government-surveillance): Legal guide to surveillance types, warrants, and Fourth Amendment rights
- [Gun Law in Missouri](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/gun-law-in-missouri): Missouri gun rights, conceal carry, and Castle Doctrine legal information

## Family Law & Relationships

- [Grandparents Rights – Custody and Visitation](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/grandparents-rights-custody-and-visitation): Missouri family law guide on grandparent custody and visitation rights

## Legal Education & History

- [Brief History of U.S. Law](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/brief-history-of-us-law): Educational guide on legal history from ancient codes to modern law

## Working with Attorneys

- [Having a Productive Meeting With Your Lawyer](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/having-a-productive-meeting-with-your-lawyer): Tips for effective attorney consultations and meeting preparation
- [Firing Your Lawyer](https://court.rchp.com/free-legal-help/library-of-legal-articles/having-a-productive-meeting-with-your-lawyer/firing-your-lawyer): Guide to terminating attorney representation and self-representation options
